name: Banana Kicks
label: banana kick
notes: Arched hollow position, feet and shoulders off floor. Kick one leg up and down.

name: Basic Crunch
label: Normal cruch
notes: Knees bent, feet flat. Crunch shoulders toward knees.

name: Crunch Pulse (Top-Range)
label: normal cruch pump
notes: Knees bent, feet flat. Small, fast pulses at top of crunch.

name: Crunch Hold
label: normal crunch hold
notes: Knees bent, feet flat. Hold at top of crunch.

name: Bent-Knee Crunch, Basic (Legs at 90°)
label: crunch with bend 90° legs
notes: Feet up, knees bent 90°. Crunch toward knees.

name: Bent-Knee Crunch, Pulse (Legs at 90°)
label: crunch with bend 90° legs
notes: Feet up, knees bent 90°. Small, fast pulses at top.

name: Bent-Knee Crunch, Hold (Legs at 90°)
label: crunch with bend 90° legs
notes: Feet up, knees bent 90°. Hold at top.

name: Flat Leg Crunch, Basic (Straight Relaxed Legs)
label: Lying with straight relaxed flat legs
notes: Legs straight and relaxed on floor. Short-range crunch, upper abs focus.

name: Flat Leg Crunch, Pulse (Straight Relaxed Legs)
label: Lying with straight relaxed flat legs
notes: Legs straight and relaxed on floor. Small, fast pulses at top.

name: Flat Leg Crunch, Hold (Straight Relaxed Legs)
label: Lying with straight relaxed flat legs
notes: Legs straight and relaxed on floor. Hold at top.

name: Straight Leg Raised Crunch, Basic
label: crunch with streight leg up
notes: Legs straight, raised toward ceiling. Crunch toward feet.

name: Straight Leg Raised Crunch, Pulse
label: crunch with streight leg up
notes: Legs straight, raised toward ceiling. Small, fast pulses at top.

name: Straight Leg Raised Crunch, Hold
label: crunch with streight leg up
notes: Legs straight, raised toward ceiling. Hold at top.

name: Figure-4 Crunch
label: figure 4
notes: One leg bent in figure-4, other leg straight. Crunch toward straight leg.

name: Bicycle Crunch
label: bicycle
notes: Pedal legs, opposite elbow to opposite knee, alternating.

name: X Crunch (Opposite Arm/Leg)
label: "X" abs
notes: Arms and legs extended in X. Bring one arm and opposite leg up to meet, alternate sides.

name: Hanging Hollow Hold (Arched, Still)
label: Abs hanging
notes: Hang from bar, hold body still in arched position.

name: Hanging Alternating Knee Raise
label: Abs hanging
notes: Hang from bar, raise knees one at a time, alternating.

name: Hanging Double Knee Raise
label: Abs hanging
notes: Hang from bar, raise both knees together.

name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
label: Abs hanging
notes: Hang from bar, raise a straight leg in front.

name: Hanging Around the World
label: Abs hanging
notes: Hang from bar, sweep a straight leg side to side in a circle.

name: L-Sit
label: I sit
notes: Arms straight down, legs extended forward at hip height. Hold.

name: TRX Fallback (Nordic-Style Hamstring Fallback)
label: Trx fall back
notes: Kneeling facing TRX, lean back slowly controlling the fall, pull back up with TRX.

name: TRX Hip Bridge Curl
label: Trx bridge
notes: Feet in TRX straps, lift hips into bridge, curl feet in toward body.

name: Side Plank Bench Leg Pump
label: Plank bench pump
notes: Side plank, one foot on bench, other leg straight underneath. Pump underneath leg up and down.

name: Resistance Band Lunge (Inward Pull)
label: In Resistance lounge
notes: Lunge with band around front leg, pulling inward.

name: Resistance Band Lunge (Outward Pull)
label: Out resistance lounge
notes: Lunge with band around front leg, pulling outward.

name: Donkey Kick Pulse (Bent Knee Up/Down)
label: Ground routine (round 1)
notes: All fours, knee bent, kick leg straight up and down.

name: Fire Hydrant (Bent Knee Sideways)
label: Ground routine (round 2)
notes: All fours, knee bent, lift leg out to the side.

name: Fire Hydrant to Extension
label: Ground routine (round 3)
notes: All fours, lift bent knee to side, extend leg straight, return to bent knee down.

name: TRX Cross Bicep Curl
label: Trx cross
notes: Facing TRX, lean back, bend elbows crossing hands toward chest.

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
label: Concentración curl
notes: Seated, elbow on knee, curl to full extension, one arm at a time.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
label: Preacher curl
notes: Roman chair, curl one dumbbell at a time.

name: TRX Y Raise
label: Trx Y
notes: Facing TRX, extend arms from front up to Y position.

name: TRX I Raise
label: Trx I
notes: Facing TRX, extend arms straight overhead to I position.

name: Resistance Band Pull (Scapula Activation)
label: Resistance pull
notes: Pull resistance band toward you, scapula engaged.

name: Ring Row (Inverted Row)
label: Ring pull
notes: Rings at knee height, legs extended, body flat. Pull body up.

name: Prone Back Extension, Basic
label: lower back routine (lying on stomach, lift torso - normal)
notes: Lying face-down, lift torso up and down using lower back.

name: Prone Back Extension, Pulse
label: lower back routine (lying on stomach, lift torso - pump)
notes: Lying face-down, lift torso. Small, fast pulses at the top.

name: Prone Back Extension, Hold
label: lower back routine (lying on stomach, lift torso - hold)
notes: Lying face-down, lift torso. Hold at the top.

name: Prone Back Extension with Side Bend, Basic
label: lower back routine (side to side - normal)
notes: Lying face-down, lift torso and move side to side.

name: Prone Back Extension with Side Bend, Pulse
label: lower back routine (side to side - pump, 3 per side)
notes: Lying face-down, lift torso. Small pulses side to side, 3 per side.

name: Prone Back Extension with Side Bend, Hold
label: lower back routine (side to side - hold)
notes: Lying face-down, lift torso and hold up. Move side to side while staying raised.

name: Prone Back Extension with Arm Reach, Basic
label: lower back routine (arms extended backward - normal)
notes: Lying face-down, lift torso, then extend arms backward.

name: Prone Back Extension with Arm Reach, Pulse
label: lower back routine (arms extended backward - pump)
notes: Lying face-down, lift torso with arms extended backward. Small pulses extending and closing arms with a slight torso movement.

name: Prone Back Extension with Arm Reach, Hold
label: lower back routine (arms extended backward - hold)
notes: Lying face-down, lift torso with arms extended backward. Hold.

name: Roman Chair Hyperextension, Rounded Spine Descent
label: lower back on Romanian chair (rounded spine to go down)
notes: On Roman chair, round the spine while lowering down.

name: Single-Leg Roman Chair Hyperextension with Rotation
label: lower back on Romanian chair (one leg, straight spine, staying up, 90° torso rotation)
notes: On Roman chair, one leg only. Keep spine straight, stay up, rotate torso 90°.

name: Dumbbell Rolling Shrug (Forward Rotation)
label: Round shrug front
notes: Dumbbell each hand, shrug up, rotate forward.

name: Dumbbell Rolling Shrug (Backward Rotation)
label: Round shrug back
notes: Dumbbell each hand, shrug up, rotate backward.

name: TRX Triceps Extension
label: Trx triceps
notes: Facing away from TRX, bend elbows, push back to extend arms. Lean forward for difficulty.

name: Seated Two-Hand Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
label: 1db press sit
notes: Seated, one dumbbell held with both hands overhead, lower behind head, press up.

name: Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension (Cross-Face)
label: 1db cross
notes: Lying down, lower dumbbell across face, extend back up.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher (Hammer Grip)
label: Db skull crusher
notes: Neutral grip, two dumbbells, lower toward head elbows back, press up.

name: Triceps Kickback (3-Point Stance)
label: 3 points push
notes: One hand on bench, dumbbell in other hand. Push weight back with triceps.

name: Incline Lying Triceps Extension
label: "reverse Fly" (Triceps section)
notes: Face-down on incline bench. Bend elbows, extend arms fully.

name: Seated EZ Bar Triceps Extension
label: Ez bar sit
notes: Seated, lower EZ bar behind head elbows back, press up.

name: Ring Support Hold (Straight-Arm)
label: ring hold
notes: Straight-arm ring support, hands rotated outward. Hold for time.

name: Ring T-Hold (Open/Close)
label: T hold progression
notes: From ring support, open arms out to sides into T, then close. Repeat.

name: Rotator Cuff Prevention Raise (Kneeling)
label: Prevention
notes: Kneeling, elbow on knee. Raise and lower arm rotating shoulder.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press (Rotated Grip)
label: Db press 90° hands
notes: Seated 90° bench, palms rotated facing you, press from ear height to full extension.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly (45°)
label: 45° fly
notes: 45° incline bench, arms extended slightly bent, open and close to sides.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press (-30°)
label: -30° db press
notes: -30° decline bench, press dumbbells from 90° elbow bend to full extension.

name: Decline Dumbbell Fly (-30°)
label: -30 fly
notes: -30° decline bench, arms extended slightly bent, open and close to sides.

name: Reverse Clamshell (Object Between Knees)
label: Reverse clamshell, using something between knee
notes: Side-lying, knees bent with an object held between them. Lift ankles apart, keeping knees together.

name: Resistance Band Abductor Lunge
label: Abductor lounge with resistance band
notes: Lunge with a resistance band around the legs, engaging the hip abductors.

name: Side Plank with Ball Push-Away Rotation
label: Abductor side plank with ball reach
notes: Side plank on left elbow, left leg bent 90°, right leg straight on top. Ball under right hand, push it away while rotating the torso, extending the right arm until facing the floor.

name: Bench Glute Stretch with Contralateral Row
label: Bench glute stretch with contralateral row (with resistance band)
notes: One leg stretched on a bench in a glute stretch position. Row with the band using the opposite-side arm.

name: Half-Kneeling Band Wood Chop (Outside Knee on Bench)
label: Band chop with outside knee on bench
notes: Half-kneeling with the outside knee up on a bench. Perform a diagonal chopping motion with the band.

name: Active Hip Flexor to Hamstring Stretch
label: Active hip flexor to hamstring stretch (on one knee, go forward/backward)
notes: Half-kneeling lunge position. Rock forward for a hip flexor stretch, then rock back for a hamstring stretch.

name: Banded Cat-Cow
label: Banded catcow
notes: On hands and knees with a band, alternate arching the spine up (cat) and dropping it down (cow).

name: Banded Eccentric Single-Leg Slider Hamstring Curl
label: Banded eccentric single leg slider hamstring curl
notes: Lying on back, one heel on a slider with band resistance. Slowly extend the leg out, then curl it back in.

name: B-Stance Reciprocal Single-Arm Row
label: B-stance reciprocal single arm row
notes: Staggered (B) stance. Perform single-arm rows, alternating sides.

name: 90° Rotational Lunge to Box Step-Up (Overhead Plate)
label: 90º weight plate rotation to box (starting from lunge position, rotate the body and land one leg on a raised box holding weight above)
notes: From a lunge position, rotate the body 90° and step one leg onto a raised box while holding a weight plate overhead.

name: Banded Thoracic Extension (45° Roman Chair)
label: Banded thoracic extension on 45º Roman chair
notes: On a 45° Roman chair, extend the upper (thoracic) spine against band resistance.

name: Banded Overhead Squat
label: Banded overhead squat
notes: Squat while holding a resistance band overhead, keeping tension throughout the movement.

name: Half-Kneeling Cross-Body Rotational Row with Contralateral Glute Stretch
label: Half kneeling rotational row cross body with contralateral glute stretch
notes: Half-kneeling position, stretching the opposite-side glute, while performing a rotational cross-body row.

name: Kettlebell-Loaded Split Stance Hip Rotation
label: Kettlebell loaded split stand hip rotation
notes: Split stance holding a kettlebell. Rotate the hips.

name: Banded Clamshell
label: Banded clamshell
notes: Side-lying, knees bent with a band above the knees. Lift the top knee apart, keeping feet together.

name: Standing Kettlebell Hip Flexion
label: Standing kettlebell hip flexion
notes: Standing, holding a kettlebell, raise the knee up against resistance.

name: Single-Leg Goblet Squat to Bench (Depth Stop)
label: Single leg goblet squat on bench
notes: Single-leg squat holding weight goblet-style at chest. Lower down until lightly touching a bench behind you, then stand back up.

name: Ring Pike Push-Up
notes: With ring, butt higher, push with shoulder.

name: EZ Bar Concentration Curl
label: Ez bar concentration curl
notes: With Roman chair.

name: Calf Raise (Open Stance)
label: calf raise open
notes: Open feet.

name: Calf Raise (Closed Stance)
label: calf raise closed
notes: Closed feet.
